args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the user's chosen export format (e.g. to localStorage) when it changes, and initialize the `format` state from that stored value instead of always defaulting to "csv", so the format menu remembers the last format used across visits.

file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
ExportButton.tsx defines `defaultFormat = "csv"` and initializes `const [format, setFormat] = useState<ExportFormat>(defaultFormat)` with no persistence (e.g. localStorage) of the user's previous selection, matching the reporter's complaint that the format menu resets to CSV every time.
